程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

接口 PlayerInventory

所有超级接口:
Inventory, Iterable<ItemStack>
public interface PlayerInventory extends Inventory
Interface to the inventory of a Player, including the four armor slots. 玩家物品栏的接口，包括四个盔甲槽位。

    • setItem

      void setItem(int index, ItemStack item)
      Stores the ItemStack at the given index of the inventory. 将 ItemStack 存储到物品栏的给定索引处。

      Indexes 0 through 8 refer to the hotbar. 9 through 35 refer to the main inventory, counting up from 9 at the top left corner of the inventory, moving to the right, and moving to the row below it back on the left side when it reaches the end of the row. It follows the same path in the inventory like you would read a book. 索引 0 到 8 对应快捷栏。9 到 35 对应主物品栏，从左上角的 9 开始计数，向右移动，到行尾后回到左侧移到下一行，就像读书的顺序一样。

      Indexes 36 through 39 refer to the armor slots. Though you can set armor with this method using these indexes, you are encouraged to use the provided methods for those slots. 索引 36 到 39 对应盔甲槽位。虽然可以用这些索引通过此方法设置盔甲，但建议使用为这些槽位提供的方法。

      If you attempt to use this method with an index less than 0 or greater than 39, an ArrayIndexOutOfBounds exception will be thrown. 若使用小于 0 或大于 39 的索引调用此方法，将抛出 ArrayIndexOutOfBounds 异常。

      指定者:
      setItem 在接口中 Inventory
      参数:
      index - The index where to put the ItemStack 放置 ItemStack 的索引
      item - The ItemStack to set 要设置的 ItemStack
      抛出:
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - when index < 0 || index > 39 当 index < 0 或 index > 39 时
      另请参阅:
      • setBoots(ItemStack)
      • setChestplate(ItemStack)
      • setHelmet(ItemStack)
      • setLeggings(ItemStack)

    • setHeldItemSlot

      void setHeldItemSlot(int slot)
      Set the slot number of the currently held item. 设置当前手持物品的槽位号。

      This validates whether the slot is between 0 and 8 inclusive. 此方法会验证槽位是否在 0 到 8 之间（含）。

      参数:
      slot - The new slot number 新的槽位号
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if slot is not between 0 and 8 inclusive 若 slot 不在 0 到 8 之间（含）

    • clear

      @Deprecated int clear(int id, int data)
      已过时。
      Magic value 魔法值
      Clears all matching items from the inventory. Setting either value to -1 will skip it's check, while setting both to -1 will clear all items in your inventory unconditionally. 清除物品栏中所有匹配的物品。将任一值设为 -1 将跳过其检查，而将两者都设为 -1 将无条件清除物品栏中的所有物品。
      参数:
      id - the id of the item you want to clear from the inventory 要从物品栏中清除的物品 id
      data - the data of the item you want to clear from the inventory 要从物品栏中清除的物品数据
      返回:
      The number of items cleared 清除的物品数量
